summary: Former lookout in Jackson County, OH (US 1569), 75 ft tall; a 1934 newspaper note says Harry S. Tripp would again occupy it; listed as gone.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone on the Forest Fire Lookout Association's Ohio list; no source we read describes what remains at the site.

events.note: Chillicothe Gazette note of October 27, 1934 says Harry S. Tripp would again occupy the tower, which suggests earlier service
Shown as the Reed Hill Lookout Tower on a 1961 map of Hamden, per the Pastmaps description

evidence.supports: October 27, 1934 note: Harry S. Tripp would again occupy the Reed Hill Tower
evidence.quote: Harry S. Tripp will again occupy the Reed Hill Tower west of Hamden in Jackson county.

evidence.supports: Forest Lookouts page lists the Ohio Department of Natural Resources for the site
Ohio list marks Reed Hill as Tower Gone
1961 map of Hamden includes the Reed Hill Lookout Tower
evidence.quote: The presence of the Reed Hill Lookout Tower and Washington Sch suggests a rural landscape

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date found; the register gives height and location only. Staffing rests on one 1934 newspaper note quoted by Forest Lookouts. The 1961 map entry is a secondary description on Pastmaps, not the map itself. ODNR comes from the Forest Lookouts header, since the register names no administering agency. The Gazette places the tower west of Hamden, which Pastmaps lists under Vinton County; the story uses Jackson County, as the register and the Gazette do. The register gives height in feet only; 22.9 m is converted from 75 ft.
